import type { EngineInterface, Timer } from 'claude-code'

import type { Activity, FileTree, HubCard, Look, ReadCost, Theme, TurnLog } from '../types'
import type { ApiMessage } from './readcost'

type Engine = EngineInterface

// The mod's own values in `$.state`, bound in register.tsx where their references stay literal.
export type StateHost = {
  tree(): Promise<FileTree>
  putTree(fn: (t: FileTree) => FileTree): Promise<void>
  activities(): Promise<Activity[]>
  setActivities(fn: (list: Activity[]) => Activity[]): Promise<void>
  turn(): Promise<TurnLog>
  setTurn(fn: (cur: TurnLog) => TurnLog): Promise<void>
  readTotal(): Promise<ReadCost | undefined>
  setReadTotal(fn: (cur: ReadCost | undefined) => ReadCost): Promise<void>
  hubCard(): Promise<HubCard | undefined>
  setHubCard(card: HubCard): Promise<void>
  look(): Promise<Look | undefined>
  setLook(look: Look): Promise<void>
  theme(): Promise<Theme | undefined>
  setTheme(theme: Theme): Promise<void>
  // Whether the MODZ hub runs, and a request for it to come forward (the "← MODZ" button).
  isHubOn(): Promise<boolean>
  goHome(): Promise<void>
  // The pane, opened when asked, now holds the MODZ panel: the hub and every other pane step aside (kit/stage.ts).
  reportShown(): Promise<void>
}

// Files, commands, the clock and the session's environment.
export type IoHost = {
  list: Engine['fs']['list']
  stat: Engine['fs']['stat']
  read(path: string): Promise<unknown>
  run: Engine['process']['run']
  now(): Promise<number>
  after(ms: number, fn: () => void): Timer
  every(ms: number, fn: () => void): Timer
  cwd(): Promise<string>
  sessionId(): Promise<string>
  // The loop's transcript as the API reads it: the main conversation, or a subagent's by its id.
  messages(agentId: string | undefined): Promise<readonly ApiMessage[]>
  tmpdir(): Promise<string | undefined>
  osEnv(): Promise<string | undefined>
  homeEnv(): Promise<string | undefined>
  herdrEnv(): Promise<string | undefined>
  herdrBin(): Promise<string | undefined>
}

// The pane, the clipboard, toasts and Claude's own settings.
export type UiHost = {
  toast(text: string): void
  // The pane by its own id: opened (focused when asked for) or retitled, and whether it is open now.
  openPane(isFocused: boolean): Promise<{ isPlaced: boolean }>
  isPaneOpen(): Promise<boolean>
  copy: Engine['ui']['copy']
  surfaces: Engine['session']['surfaces']
  config: Engine['config']['list']
}

// The engine's reach, bound in register.tsx: the engine follows `$` only into functions of the hooks module's own
// file, so every other module gets this port instead.
export type Host = StateHost & IoHost & UiHost

export function patch(h: Host, fn: (t: FileTree) => Partial<FileTree>): Promise<void> {
  return h.putTree(t => ({ ...t, ...fn(t) }))
}

import type { Timer } from 'claude-code'

import type { Change } from './gitstatus'
import type { Background } from './gitjobs'
import type { PendingRead, Rate, StepSize } from './readcost'

// One model loop (the main one, or a subagent's by its id): its turn, its last request's size, and the reads its
// last step ran, waiting for the next request to measure them.
export type Loop = { turnId: string; size: StepSize | null; pending: PendingRead[] }

// What the hooks share for the session beyond `$.state`: the person's options, the pane's last window and the
// work in flight. A hot reload starts it afresh, as it did the hooks module's own variables.
export const mem = {
  blink: null as Timer | null,
  themePoll: null as Timer | null,
  themeMtime: null as number | null,
  generation: 0,
  lastPress: { key: '', at: 0 },
  noNerd: false,
  glyphSetting: 'auto',
  follow: true,
  followClaude: true,
  queuedReads: [] as string[],
  showReads: true,
  showWrites: true,
  searchIndex: null as { root: string; paths: Promise<string[]> } | null,
  activityId: 0,
  pointer: true,
  view: { from: 0, max: 0 },
  lastSync: 0,
  noDock: false,
  home: '',
  dirty: { root: '', files: {} } as { root: string; files: Record<string, Change> },
  lastRoot: '',
  sizeDefault: false,
  sizeEpoch: 0,
  sizeQueue: [] as string[],
  background: new Map<string, Background>(),
  loops: new Map<string, Loop>(),
  rate: { tokens: 0, chars: 0 } as Rate,
}

export function fileIcon(n: FileNode, open: boolean, isRepo: boolean): string {
  if (n.kind === 'link') return cp(0xf481)
  if (n.kind === 'dir' && isRepo) return cp(0xf02a2)
  if (n.kind === 'dir') return cp(open ? 0xe5fe : 0xe5ff)
  const lower = n.name.toLowerCase()
  const named = NAMES[lower]
  if (named) return cp(named)
  const dot = lower.lastIndexOf('.')
  const ext = dot >= 0 ? lower.slice(dot + 1) : ''
  return cp(EXTS[ext] ?? 0xf0214)
}

export const GIT_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  A: '#98c379',
  '?': '#98c379',
  R: '#61afef',
  C: '#61afef',
  M: '#e5c07b',
  T: '#e5c07b',
}

const PRIORITY = ['U', 'D', 'M', 'T', 'R', 'C', 'A', '?']

export function stronger(a: string | undefined, b: string): string {
  if (!a) return b
  return PRIORITY.indexOf(b) < PRIORITY.indexOf(a) ? b : a
}

export const LINUX_LAUNCH = 'setsid -f -w "$@" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 1; kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; wait "$p"'

export const LINUX_OPEN = [
  'set -f',
  'f=$1',
  'if command -v gio >/dev/null; then',
  '  if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v file >/dev/null && encoding=$(file -b --mime-encoding -- "$f") && [ -n "$encoding" ] && [ "$encoding" != binary ]; then',
  '    case $(gio info -a standard::content-type -- "$f" | sed -n \'s/.*standard::content-type: //p\') in',
  '      video/* | audio/*)',
  '        app=$(xdg-mime query default text/plain)',
  '        IFS=:',
  '        for dir in "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}" ${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}; do',
  '          [ -n "$app" ] && [ -f "$dir/applications/$app" ] && exec gio launch "$dir/applications/$app" "$f"',
  '        done',
  '        echo "No text/plain desktop application found for $f" >&2',
  '        exit 1',
  '        ;;',
  '    esac',
  '  fi',
  '  if (exec gio open "$f"); then exit 0; fi',
  'fi',
  'exec xdg-open "$f"',
].join('\n')

const WIN_OPEN = "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; [Diagnostics.Process]::Start([Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]@{ FileName = $env:PANE_OPEN_TARGET; UseShellExecute = $true }) | Out-Null"

function argvOf(os: 'linux' | 'darwin' | 'win32', target: string): string[] {
  if (os === 'linux') return ['sh', '-c', LINUX_LAUNCH, 'sh', 'sh', '-c', LINUX_OPEN, 'sh', target]
  return os === 'darwin' ? ['open', '--', target] : ['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', WIN_OPEN]
}

export function openCommand(os: 'linux' | 'darwin' | 'win32', target: string) {
  const argv = argvOf(os, target)
  return {
    argv,
    init: {
      timeoutMs: 10_000,
      ...(os === 'win32' ? { env: { PANE_OPEN_TARGET: /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(target) ? target : target.replace(/\//g, '\\') } } : {}),
    },
  }
}

const EN = {
  reasons: {
    nothing: 'nothing to commit', identity: 'git identity not set', notRepo: 'not a git repository', conflicts: 'conflicts not resolved',
    sign: 'could not sign', emptyMessage: 'commit message is empty', locked: 'git is locked (index.lock)', hook: 'a git hook stopped it',
  } satisfies Record<Reason, string>,
  committed: 'committed',
  committedIn: (place: string) => `committed · ${place}`,
  noCommit: (reason: string) => `no commit: ${reason}`,
  noCommitMade: 'no commit made',
  commitRan: 'git commit ran',
  failed: (verb: string) => `${verb} failed`,
  ran: (kind: string) => `${kind} ran`,
}

type GitWords = typeof EN

const TR: GitWords = {
  reasons: {
    nothing: 'değişiklik yok', identity: 'git kimliği ayarlı değil', notRepo: 'git deposu değil', conflicts: 'çakışma çözülmemiş',
    sign: 'imza atılamadı', emptyMessage: 'commit mesajı boş', locked: 'git kilidi açık (index.lock)', hook: 'bir git kancası durdurdu',
  },
  committed: 'commit edildi',
  committedIn: place => `commit edildi · ${place}`,
  noCommit: reason => `commit olmadı: ${reason}`,
  noCommitMade: 'commit oluşmadı',
  commitRan: 'git commit çalıştı',
  failed: verb => `${verb} başarısız`,
  ran: kind => `${kind} çalıştı`,
}

export const gitWords = (): GitWords => pick({ en: EN, tr: TR })

// What a git or gh verb says while it runs and once done; the verb itself when nothing is written for it.
export const saidOf = (verb: string): Said => pick({ en: EN_VERBS, tr: TR_VERBS })[verb] ?? { running: verb, done: verb }
